# Commit message guidelines

## Rules
- Should be concise and clear
- Use the present tense ("add feature" not "added feature")
- Use the imperative mood ("move cursor to..." not "moves cursor to...")
- Limit the first line to 72 characters or fewer
- When the change is complex, add further details in the next lines. Still, be concise.
- If appropriate, add emoji at the beginning

## Example
```
:construction_worker: |  add a new db client

- added new repositories
- refactored something
```
